title: Overmarine Group Debuts Fifth Mangusta Oceano 50
description: Overmarine Group unveils the fifth Mangusta Oceano 50, a stunning superyacht blending luxury, performance, and innovative design by Alberto Mancini.
html:
Overmarine Group has successfully launched the fifth vessel in its Mangusta Oceano 50 series, a 50-meter displacement yacht that remains just under the 500 GT threshold. This latest addition to the series highlights the shipyard’s commitment to delivering state-of-the-art superyachts that balance performance with design elegance. The Mangusta Oceano 50 series, known for its sophisticated engineering and attention to detail, continues to attract discerning clients, with Moran Yachts facilitating the sale of this unit.

Since its inception, the Mangusta Oceano 50 series has seen four previous deliveries, each showcasing Overmarine Group’s dedication to innovation and quality. Founded in 1985 by the Balducci family, Overmarine Group has established itself as a leader in the construction of both open and displacement power superyachts, operating under the Mangusta and Mangusta Oceanco brands. The launch of this fifth yacht reinforces the shipyard’s reputation for excellence in yacht manufacturing.

Innovative Design by Alberto Mancini Enhances Connectivity

The design of the Mangusta Oceano 50 is the result of a collaboration between designer Alberto Mancini and Overmarine’s technical department. This partnership has produced a yacht that emphasizes seamless indoor-outdoor connectivity, a hallmark of modern yacht design. Floor-to-ceiling windows and expansive glazing are key features that allow natural light to flood the interior, creating a harmonious connection with the surrounding seascape.

Accommodation on the yacht includes five cabins, with a full-beam master suite located on the main deck. This suite is notable for its automated balcony, offering a private space to enjoy ocean views. The lower deck is home to four additional guest cabins and a gymnasium, ensuring comfort and convenience for all on board. The thoughtful design extends to the yacht’s layout, which maximizes space and enhances the overall onboard experience.

Powerful Performance and Luxurious Amenities on Display

The Mangusta Oceano 50 is powered by twin MTU 12V 2000 M86 engines, each delivering 1,700 horsepower. This configuration allows the yacht to reach a top speed of 16 knots, with a cruising range of 4,500 nautical miles at 11 knots. Such performance capabilities ensure that the vessel is not only a statement of style but also a formidable presence on the water.

Outdoor areas of the yacht are designed to provide a range of amenities for relaxation and entertainment. Three connected beach club terraces offer ample space for leisure, while two swimming pools, including a 6.5×2.6-meter pool with a countercurrent system, cater to swimming enthusiasts. Multiple lounge and dining areas are strategically placed across the decks, and the sun deck features an infinity pool that visually merges with the horizon, enhancing the sense of tranquility on board.

The launch of the fifth Mangusta Oceano 50 yacht underscores Overmarine Group’s expertise in crafting high-performance superyachts that prioritize innovative design and functionality. With its impressive design, powerful performance, and comprehensive amenities, this vessel is a testament to the shipyard’s enduring legacy in the yachting industry.
